title: About Blossom Facade Water Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 546 recent saved-signal files and 79 captured links, then narrowed the page to 7 source windows around Richard Nadler — Cinematic Digital Art Portfolio and @richardnadler | SuperRare, plus 5 more. A source image from richardnadler.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Blossom Facade Water Section: Architectural section as occult garden stage: a right-heavy mustard-and-cobalt facade scaffold with balcony bands, corrugated panels, and dark diagonal roof cuts, invaded by a luminous upper-left blossom canopy. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 7 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against mustard corrugated facade panels, cobalt pond cut through stones, and red-white stitched mezzanine rail.
